lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern along the mid-lateral flank, transitioning from dense clusters in the anterior region to more spaced rows toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating fixed nodes of high luminance across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extending horizontally along the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and distinct shadowing on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains at least six distinct high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily within the lower two-thirds of the fin's surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A discernible irregular notch is present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; a small high-contrast white mark is visible on the leading edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast alphanumeric text is superimposed over the central lower-quadrant of the shark's flank; multiple human figures in snorkeling gear are visible in the upper background water column.
